entities.name: Hans Fischböck
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Fischböck was an Austrian banker who was the economics minister and minister of finance of Austria and the finance minister of Nazi-occupied Netherlands. He escaped to Argentina after World War II, only returning to Europe after the granting of a general amnesty.
